title: Magic Boxes
goal: A variable is a box with a name. Put something in, get it back later.
mascot_lines: Now whenever we say NAME, the computer thinks 'Sam'.
Boxes hold things for us. Drag the right thing into each box!

payload.prompt: Drag each thing into its labeled box.
